resources.string: No cap. The battery charges to 100 percent.
The ROM decides when to hold the charge, based on your habits.
Hold the charge at the cap this ROM defines. 80 percent on this device.
This control uses a Xiaomi setting and no Xiaomi ROM marker was found on this device, so it is not offered.

The setting has no value yet on this build, which reads as intelligent charging. Each mode is still verified by reading the setting back, so a mode this ROM does not support will be reported as not applied.
The ROM reserves the right to charge fully when scheduled, even while battery protection is on. Seeing 100 percent is then the ROM, not this app.
Root is not needed here: shell access is enough, and the system battery settings screen follows every change.
